resources.string: Receive one standalone APK from a paired Mac, up to 1 GiB. The filename comes from the Mac; Android verifies the actual application. Each installation requires your approval here and system confirmation.
Installation records are unavailable. Reopen DroidMatch; if this persists, contact the maintainer. Existing system sessions have been preserved.
System-confirmed installation is unavailable in this device configuration.
Incoming installation requests are enabled for this connection.
Android allows DroidMatch to request installation.
First allow DroidMatch as an installation source in Android settings.
Enable the secure USB connection, Android source permission, and incoming requests before continuing.
The action could not finish. Check the current state and retry the available action.
Approve this APK for system installation
Waiting for the APK from Mac
Transfer integrity verified · Waiting for your approval
Waiting for the system installation result
Installation failed or the APK was rejected
Cleanup incomplete · Retry cleanup before a new request
System result unknown · Check on this phone before retrying
Unknown result acknowledged · Installation success is not confirmed

Check whether the app was installed using Android first. This action attempts to cancel any remaining DroidMatch session and allows a new request only after that session is gone. It does not uninstall an app, confirm success, or retry installation.
DroidMatch found its own system installation sessions without a matching record. Cancel these sessions to allow new requests. Installed applications are unaffected.
Android could not open installation settings. Open DroidMatch’s app settings and check the permission to install unknown apps.
USB endpoint is ready. Tap for pairing and folders.
Enable a local USB endpoint when you want a Mac to connect. Product sessions require pairing; turning it off closes every active connection.
Turn on the local endpoint below when you are ready to connect a Mac.
Keep this screen open while DroidMatch starts its local USB endpoint.
USB is ready. Open a pairing window and approve only if both six-digit codes match.
Open DroidMatch on your Mac to browse and transfer files over the authenticated USB session.
Turn off the USB connection, try again, and re-pair if trusted devices remain unavailable.
Paired Macs: unavailable · Added folders: unavailable
Secure USB is ready for a paired Mac
Open a short pairing window, then compare the six-digit code shown here with the code on your Mac. Approve only when both codes match.
Pairing window open. Waiting for a Mac.
Pairing request from %1$s. Pairing code %2$s. Compare it with your Mac before approving.
Review every Mac trusted to reconnect. Removing one closes the current USB connection so revoked access ends immediately.
Paired Macs are temporarily unavailable. Retry before pairing again.
Some pairing records could not be verified. Verified Macs remain listed below; the total is unavailable.
Its saved name and other metadata are hidden because they could not be authenticated.
This removes only this unverifiable record and closes the current USB connection. The Mac, if any, will need to pair again.
The damaged record could not be removed and verified. The paired-Mac total remains unavailable; retry later.
“%1$s” will need to pair again. The current USB connection will be closed.
This Mac could not be removed. Turn off the USB connection and try again.
Choose what a paired Mac may browse. Android can grant all media or only the photos and videos you select.
All photos and videos are available
Limited access: selected items or only one media type is available
Photo and video browsing is off
Android could not open this app’s settings. Open Settings and choose DroidMatch to change media access.
Allow a paired Mac to browse and export music and audio files. On Android 13 or later, music access is separate from photo and video access.
Add a folder through Android’s system picker. DroidMatch keeps only the permission you explicitly grant.
Android did not confirm persistent access to this folder. Try choosing it again.
Android could not open the system folder picker. Check device or work-profile restrictions, then try again.
DroidMatch will no longer expose “%1$s” to paired Macs.
Android still reports this folder as authorized. Try again or remove DroidMatch’s folder access in system settings.
Allow paired Macs to view launchable app names, package IDs, versions, and update times. Turn sharing off or stop secure USB to end access.
Separately allow paired Macs to export the installed APK files of shared apps, including every split. App data is excluded. Enable app sharing first; this permission ends when secure USB stops.
APK export is allowed for this connection.
